أسئلة شائعة

Yes. You can upgrade to Pro at any time and your new limits take effect immediately. Downgrading to Free takes effect at the end of your billing cycle.
A run is a single extraction request for one post URL. On the Free plan each run fetches up to 100 comments. Pro removes this cap entirely.
We accept all major credit cards and local Iraqi payment options. For Enterprise, bank transfer and invoicing are also available.
Enterprise customers receive a REST API key that lets you trigger extractions, retrieve results, and push data into your own systems programmatically. Full API documentation is provided on sign-up.
The Free plan is always available with no time limit, so you can evaluate the tool before upgrading. We don't currently offer a timed Pro trial.
